order_semantics: classification precedence, NOT a risk ranking

common_fields.censored_rule: censored mark loss counts for D1/D3/D5 eligibility but is reported separately (completed vs censored panels)

D4_sudden_break.pre_break_dd_rule: episode max DD before the break day remains non-severe (dd_log > -0.1053605156578263)

D2_late_false_recovery.clock: same frozen false-recovery failure condition as T6.3 F3; FIRST occurs at effective-observation offset > 5 after A0; MUST be actually observed within the episode horizon (censoring is not late failure)
D2_late_false_recovery.f3_boundary: failure_offset <= 5 -> already F3 (T6.3 frozen); failure_offset > 5 -> D2-eligible within F6 input set; not observed -> not D2

F6'_mandatory_residual.note: large residual is NOT failure; GOOD-heavy F6' may show the existing failure taxonomy has no reason to call these episodes failures. T7.4 success is NOT measured by a low residual rate. No threshold retuning after seeing the distribution.

gate_additions.G34_component_provenance_replay: every condition variable (cycle count, endpoint return, exposure occupancy, pre-break DD, single-day return, D2 failure clock) independently replayed from frozen T6/T7 facts; runner-side ad-hoc recomputation of near-equivalent versions is forbidden

provenance.design_commit: b76d653 (v1) + ratified v2 in freeze commit
provenance.ancestry_assertion: this taxonomy freeze precedes any F6 outcome distribution read / t7_4 product; verifiable by git history order
